necessary_context.content: Euclidean R^d; f:R^d->R is convex and continuously differentiable, with ||grad f(x)-grad f(y)||<=L||x-y|| for every x,y. L>0; argmin f is nonempty; choose x* with ||x0-x*||<=R, R>0, and f*=f(x*). The first-order oracle returns exact (f(x),grad f(x)).
necessary_context.name: Standing model

necessary_context.content: Fixed h>0; x_(i+1)=x_i-(h/L)grad f(x_i), i=0,...,N-1. Output x_N. N oracle calls produce the output; an optional endpoint evaluation to observe f(x_N) is additional.
necessary_context.name: GM and query budget

necessary_context.content: Theorem 3.1 asserts the upper bound for 0<h<=1. Theorem 3.2 constructs an existential instance for fixed-step GM and last iterate for every h>0. The proposed upper bound for 0<h<2 is explicitly Conjecture 3.1 in this artifact.
